verdict.rationale: Temporal documents a programmatic Client API that applications use to start Workflow Executions, send Signals and Queries, retrieve results, and manage Standalone Activities. Its SDKs expose documented APIs for Workflow and Activity execution, and an official CLI covers management tasks. missing for 10: an explicit wire-level (gRPC/HTTP) API reference in the evidence, a machine-readable API spec (the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: A Temporal Client acts as the bridge for communication between your applications and the Temporal Service, enabling you to start Workflow Executions, send Signals and Queries, and retrieve results.
They feature APIs for Workflow and Activity execution, automatic retries, and resilience mechanisms
Start and manage [Standalone Activities](/standalone-activity) directly, without involving a Workflow
